verdict.rationale: Gmail's own Gemini integration can organize the inbox when asked, e.g. adding labels or deleting multiple emails. That is on-demand AI organization, not autonomous triage. Rule-based filters and search operators are a different, non-AI feature and earn no credit. Missing for 10: automatic AI labeling/categorization of incoming mail, AI surfacing of what needs attention, documented ways to steer the AI's triage behavior, an audit trail of AI actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit

citations.quote: Organize: Ask Gemini to do things like delete multiple emails or add labels.
